items.exampleEn: The laser cuts metal as easily as paper.
items.exampleZh: 雷射切金屬就像切紙一樣容易。

items.exampleEn: Programming is now taught in many primary schools.
items.exampleZh: 現在很多小學都有教程式設計。

items.exampleEn: The police use radar to catch drivers who go too fast.
items.exampleZh: 警察用雷達抓開太快的駕駛。

items.exampleEn: A thermometer in the fish tank tells us if the water is warm enough.
items.exampleZh: 魚缸裡的溫度計告訴我們水夠不夠溫暖。

items.exampleEn: A modern computer chip has billions of transistors.
items.exampleZh: 一顆現代電腦晶片裡有幾十億個電晶體。

items.exampleEn: Workers in the factory wear antistatic clothes.
items.exampleZh: 工廠裡的工人穿著抗靜電的衣服。

items.exampleEn: Nano materials can be thousands of times thinner than a hair.
items.exampleZh: 奈米材料可以比頭髮還薄好幾千倍。

items.exampleEn: Some pilots now practice in virtual reality before they fly real planes.
items.exampleZh: 現在有些飛行員在駕駛真正的飛機前，會先在虛擬實境中練習。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher used a laser light to point at the map on the screen.
items.sentenceZh: 老師用雷射光指著螢幕上的地圖。

items.audioEn: The thermometer outside shows only two degrees, so wear your warmest coat.
items.audioZh: 外面的溫度計只有兩度，所以穿上你最保暖的外套吧。

items.sentenceEn: Jobs in programming are well-paid in this city.
items.sentenceZh: 在這個城市，程式設計的工作薪水很高。

items.sentenceEn: Ships use radar to find their way in thick fog.
items.sentenceZh: 船隻在濃霧中用雷達找路。

items.stemEn: The first ____ radio was small enough to carry in a pocket.
items.stemZh: 第一台電晶體收音機小到可以放在口袋裡帶著走。

items.stemEn: Computer parts are packed in ____ bags to protect them from electricity.
items.stemZh: 電腦零件裝在抗靜電袋裡，保護它們不受電的影響。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I visited a technology fair in Taipei. At the first stand, a manufacturer showed a tiny transistor made with nano technology, so small that we needed a special camera to see it. Next, I tried a virtual reality game in which I walked on the moon. A company that makes weather radar explained how it can follow storms from hundreds of kilometers away. Another stand sold laser tools that measure a room in seconds. Children could join a short programming class and make a robot dance. I also bought a smart thermometer for my kitchen. Visitors had to wear antistatic gloves before touching the components on display.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我去參觀了台北的一場科技展。在第一個攤位，一家製造商展示了用奈米技術做成的微小電晶體，小到我們得用特殊的相機才看得到。接著，我玩了一個虛擬實境遊戲，在遊戲裡我在月球上走路。一家生產氣象雷達的公司解釋了雷達如何追蹤幾百公里外的暴風雨。另一個攤位賣能在幾秒內量出房間大小的雷射工具。孩子們可以參加簡短的程式課，讓機器人跳舞。我還買了一支廚房用的智慧溫度計。參觀者摸展示的零件前，必須先戴上抗靜電手套。

questions.questionZh: 作者在虛擬實境遊戲裡做了什麼？
氣象雷達公司解釋了什麼？
options: 怎麼用雷射在幾秒內量出房間大小
雷達能追蹤幾百公里外的暴風雨
如何做一個會跳舞的機器人

items.promptZh: 這家博物館用虛擬實境讓遊客看到古代的城市。
referenceEn: This museum uses virtual reality to show visitors ancient cities.
The museum lets visitors see an ancient city through virtual reality.
rubricZh: 「虛擬實境」可寫，例如 virtual reality、VR 等
「讓遊客看到」可寫，例如 show visitors、let visitors see 等

items.instructionZh: 用 laser 造一個句子，說說你看過或用過的雷射（例如雷射筆、雷射燈光秀）。
referenceEn: I saw an amazing laser show at a concert last year.
The shop used a laser to cut my name into a wooden sign.
rubricZh: laser 的用法，例如 a laser show、use a laser 等（可當名詞，也可放在名詞前）
時態合理（例如 saw、used 等）
